jobs.description:
You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
• Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset

Your responsibilities as Finance Manager Belgium:

• Manage the full accounting cycle from A to Z and provide hands-on operational support where needed.
• Work within a very small team and take responsibility for managing and guiding the team.
• Closely monitor month-end closings, VAT, Intrastat, Recupel/Recybat, and tax preparation.
• Support the budgeting and forecasting process and ensure timely and accurate reporting of P&L, cash flow, and KPIs.
• Analyse financial figures, identify risks and opportunities, and proactively support the Managing Director as a trusted financial business partner.
• Ensure the accounting processing of payroll and contribute to the follow-up of financial and HR-related matters.
 

 

 

 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field, or have developed an equivalent level of expertise through relevant experience in finance, audit, or controlling.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English and communicate confidently and professionally with various stakeholders.
• You are a hands-on Finance Manager who enjoys bringing structure, taking responsibility, and remaining operationally involved.
• You work accurately and analytically, take initiative, and have a decisive and results-oriented mindset.
• You have strong people management skills and know how to manage deadlines and month-end closings efficiently.
• Ideally, you have 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar financial role within an SME environment.
• Knowledge of SAP is considered an asset.

The client is a global leader in the sustainable construction industry, focused on delivering innovative building solutions while prioritising environmental and social impact. They foster a collaborative, people-centric culture that emphasizes employee well-being, diversity, and continuous growth in an international setting.

Jobomschrijving

As a Product Manager your responsibilities are:

• Gather and translate customer and market insights into product ideas and improvements
• Oversee the full product lifecycle, from initial concept through launch to discontinuation
• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and expand the global product portfolio
• Track product performance and support forecasting with data-driven analysis
• Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., sales, R&D, marketing) to deliver on strategic goals
• Contribute to long-term planning and initiatives aimed at driving growth in international markets

A successful Product Manager should have:

• Proven experience managing products in an international B2B environment, ideally within the construction sector
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies
• Solid business acumen, including building and managing financial cases and performance metrics
• Technically savvy, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach to innovation
• Effective project manager, capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting
• Excellent communicator who collaborates easily across teams and with external stakeholders
• Adaptable, hands-on, and comfortable working in a dynamic, evolving environment
• Willing and able to travel frequently across regions
• Fluent in English, with strong interpersonal skills to operate in a global context

Our client is a global leader in connecting, fixing, lifting, and anchoring technology for the construction industry. Part of a major international group, they operate across 60 locations worldwide and contribute to some of the most sustainable and cutting-edge building projects globally, including the Paris Metro Rail project, the Burj Khalifa, and the Kennedy Space Centre. 

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and implement the CI program in consultation with site managers.
• Ensure follow-up and successful delivery of projects from start to finish.
• Lead multiple projects, both large and small, from design to execution.
• Craft custom solutions and provide expert insights to exceed client expectations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, management, and contractors to ensure project success.
• Develop, layout, and optimize industrial processes.
• Collect and analyze data to design, test, and implement new or improved processes.
• Support CI projects and Kaizen initiatives on-site.
• Implement best practices from other sites and help transition to Industry 4.0.
• Contribute to automation projects and build stability and productivity on critical machines.
• Supervise operational and CI projects from start to finish with the site team.
• Deliver training related to Kaizen, VSM, and CI methodologies.

• Engineering degree.
• Proven experience in process improvement, Lean tools, and project management.
• ERP systems knowledge.
• Familiarity with drawing packages and programming tools for robotics.
• Dutch, French, and English.
• Strong analytical skills, technical insight, and ability to work under deadlines.

Our client is a recognized provider of data, analytics, and insights for the automotive industry. With a strong international footprint, the organization supports key market players, including leasing companies, insurers, manufacturers, and importers, in making informed, data-driven decisions.

In Belgium, the company operates through a small, agile team while being fully integrated into a larger international network of experts and analysts.

Jobomschrijving

As Business Analyst BeNeLux, your main responsibilities will be to :

• Produce and maintain residual value forecasts for new and used vehicles across BeNeLux region
• Analyze large datasets using statistical methods and proprietary algorithms to generate accurate market predictions
• Continuously monitor automotive market trends, pricing developments, and competitor activity
• Apply strong market knowledge to complement and refine data-driven models
• Contribute to improving valuation methodologies and analytical tools
• Collaborate with a network of market analysts across Europe to ensure consistency and best practices
• Support commercial teams with insights for client interactions when needed
• Participate occasionally in industry events and client meetings across the region

• Strong analytical mindset with experience working with data (preferably in automotive, leasing, insurance, or related industries)
• Solid understanding of the automotive market, including vehicle pricing and trends
• Experience in data analysis, statistical modelling, or similar analytical work
• Comfortable working with large datasets and improving analytical models
• Autonomous, self-driven, and able to work effectively in a fully remote environment
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in international, virtual teams
• Fluent in French, Dutch, English

Our client is a global leader in food manufacturing, known for its strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.

The Process Expert plays a key role in optimizing production processes, leading new product introductions, and improving plant performance across liquid and solid chocolate processing operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead new product introduction (NPI), process transfers, and factory trials
• Optimize production lines to improve throughput, reduce waste and losses
• Define and implement process standards, work instructions and recipes
• Collaborate with R&D, quality, engineering and operations teams
• Analyze process performance and identify continuous improvement actions
• Support and coach shopfloor teams on best practices and standards
• Manage process validation linked to chocolate liquid & solid processing
• Drive product industrialization and ensure compliance with quality standards

• Engineering degree (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or similar)
• First experience in FMCG / food / process industry
• Strong knowledge of chocolate or similar processing technologies: Mixing, refining, conching, tempering, depositing
• Understanding of rheology and process parameters
• Familiarity with SAP, MES or industrial automation tools
• Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to influence, train and engage operational teams
• Fluent in English (and French/Dutch preferred)

•

• Develop the overall AI vision and roadmap for the fund and its portfolio companies
• Identify high-impact use cases (productivity gains, revenue growth, cost optimization)
• 

Drive Execution

• Ensure effective rollout from strategy design to execution (PoCs, scaling)
• 

Engage with Senior Leadership
• Work closely with investment teams and portfolio company leadership (C-level)
• Challenge and support management teams in adopting new technologies
• 

Value Creation

• Experience: 3-7 years in a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB strongly preferred)

• Skills:
• Strong analytical and strategic thinking
• Hands-on, execution-driven mindset
• Ability to interact with senior stakeholders
• Languages: Fluent in English + French or Dutch required

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Our partner is part of an international company operating in the retail industry. To strengthen their Sales Support team, they are looking for a German-speaking Sales Support Specialist to assist both Account Managers and customers throughout their projects.

You will join a dynamic and sustainable work environment where growth, collaboration, and respect are at the heart of the company culture. Thanks to a structured onboarding program, you will quickly get up to speed and become a valued member of the team from day one.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• You will work closely with our distributor network & managing projects.
• You will advise customers on the best solutions.
• Throughout each project, you will build and maintain strong commercial relationships with your customers.
• You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.
• You will communicate daily with customers and suppliers to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
• You will handle customer complaints professionally by investigating issues and implementing appropriate solutions, working closely with the Account Manager when needed.
• You will monitor backorders and process product returns accurately and efficiently.
• You will ensure accurate invoicing, prepare credit notes, and follow up on outstanding payments.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who:

• Has a strong customer focus and is passionate about delivering excellent service.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys learning new skills.
• Takes initiative and enjoys working on a variety of projects.
• Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
• Has a positive attitude and enjoys collaborating as part of a team.
• Has a hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
• Is fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.
• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

For an international production company specializing in high-quality technologies in Deinze, we are looking for an Operator responsible for finishing work (3 shifts).

What will you do?

• Finishing targets: polishing and conventional turning of metal and ceramic targets (long profiles up to 5 meters)
• Finishing is primarily done by machine, but can sometimes be done by hand
• Performing various quality controls
• Recording data (Excel, MES, ERP)
• Reporting and documenting deviations in collaboration with the quality control supervisor
• Packaging in protective film
• Preparing products for collection

Who are you?

• You have strong mechanical insight and can read technical drawings
• You work precisely and accurately
• In possession of an A2 diploma, preferably in a mechanical engineering field
• Good command of English
• You are willing to work in a 3-shift system
• You work comfortably with computers: Excel, MES and/or ERP
• Physically fit: lifting & applying force
